mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CBCI_USER WHERE USER_TYPE = 2 AND WITHDRAW_YN IS NULL

SELECT ${prdNo}, IFNULL(CUBICI_CODE, "null") AS CUBICI_CODE, INPUT_DATE FROM (
SELECT ${prdNo}, CUBICI_CODE, LEFT(INPUT_DATE, 10) AS INPUT_DATE FROM CBCI_${SHOP_NAME}_GOODS UNION
SELECT ${prdNo}, CUBICI_CODE, LEFT(INPUT_DATE, 10) AS INPUT_DATE FROM CBCI_${SHOP_NAME}_STOCK ORDER BY CUBICI_CODE DESC ) CODE GROUP BY INPUT_DATE

SELECT CONCAT(PRODUCT_NO,OPTION1,OPTION2) AS UNIQUE_OPTION,
SELECT CONCAT(PRODUCT_NO,OPTION1,OPTION2,OPTION3) AS UNIQUE_OPTION,
SELECT CONCAT(ITEM_NO,OPTION1,OPTION2,OPTION3) AS UNIQUE_OPTION,
SELECT CONCAT(PRODUCT_NO,MIX_DTL_OPT_NM) AS UNIQUE_OPTION,
SELECT ${prdNo} AS UNIQUE_OPTION,
SELECT CONCAT(PRODUCT_NO, OPTION_NM_1, OPTION_NM_2, OPTION_NM_3) AS UNIQUE_OPTION,
CUBICI_CODE, LEFT(INPUT_DATE, 10) AS INPUT_DATE FROM CBCI_${SHOP_NAME}_STOCK WHERE LEFT(INPUT_DATE, 10) = #{inputDate} AND CUBICI_CODE IS NULL ORDER BY ${prdNo}, INPUT_DATE

SELECT DISTINCT GOODS.CUBICI_CODE, GOODS.${prdNo} AS UNIQUE_OPTION, LEFT(GOODS.INPUT_DATE, 10) AS INPUT_DATE FROM CBCI_${SHOP_NAME}_GOODS GOODS LEFT JOIN CBCI_${SHOP_NAME}_STOCK STOCK ON GOODS.${prdNo} = STOCK.${prdNo} WHERE STOCK.${prdNo} IS NULL AND GOODS.CUBICI_CODE IS NULL AND LEFT(GOODS.INPUT_DATE, 10) = #{inputDate}
AND GOODS.OPTION_YN = "미사용"
AND GOODS.OPTION_YN = "N"
ORDER BY GOODS.${prdNo}, GOODS.INPUT_DATE

SELECT FIRST_CAL.*, GROUP_CONCAT(FIRST_CAL.SHOP SEPARATOR '^') AS MATCHING_TABLE FROM (SELECT 'INTERPARK_GOODS' AS SHOP, CIG.SHOP_ID, CIG.CUBICI_CODE, CIG.MATCHING_CODE, CIG.SELLER_PRODUCT_CODE AS MANAGE_CODE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_GOODS CIG WHERE CIG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{interpark_id}) AND CIG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CIG.SELLER_PRODUCT_CODE) <> '' AND CIG.MATCHING_CANCEL IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'INTERPARK_STOCK' AS SHOP, CIS.SHOP_ID, CIS.CUBICI_CODE, CIS.MATCHING_CODE, CIS.MANAGE_CODE AS MANAGE_CODE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_STOCK CIS WHERE CIS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{interpark_id}) AND CIS.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CIS.MANAGE_CODE) <> '' AND CIS.MATCHING_CANCEL IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'GMARKET_GOODS' AS SHOP, CGG.SHOP_ID, CGG.CUBICI_CODE, CGG.MATCHING_CODE, CGG.SELLER_PRODUCT_CODE AS MANAGE_CODE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_GOODS CGG WHERE CGG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{gmarket_id}) AND CGG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CGG.SELLER_PRODUCT_CODE) <> '' AND CGG.MATCHING_CANCEL IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'GMARKET_STOCK' AS SHOP, CGS.SHOP_ID, CGS.CUBICI_CODE, CGS.MATCHING_CODE, CGS.MANAGE_CODE AS MANAGE_CODE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_STOCK CGS WHERE CGS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{gmarket_id}) AND CGS.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CGS.MANAGE_CODE) <> '' AND CGS.MATCHING_CANCEL IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'AUCTION_GOODS' AS SHOP, CAG.SHOP_ID, CAG.CUBICI_CODE, CAG.MATCHING_CODE, CAG.MANAGEMENT_CODE AS MANAGE_CODE FROM CBCI_AUCTION_GOODS CAG WHERE CAG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{auction_id}) AND CAG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAG.MANAGEMENT_CODE) <> '' AND CAG.MATCHING_CANCEL IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT '11ST_GOODS' AS SHOP, CSG.SHOP_ID, CSG.CUBICI_CODE, CSG.MATCHING_CODE, CSG.SELLER_PRD_CD AS MANAGE_CODE FROM CBCI_11ST_GOODS CSG WHERE CSG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{eleven_id}) AND CSG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CSG.SELLER_PRD_CD) <> '' AND CSG.MATCHING_CANCEL IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'COUPANG_STOCK' AS SHOP, CCS.SHOP_ID, CCS.CUBICI_CODE, CCS.MATCHING_CODE, CCS.EXTERNAL_VENDOR_SKU AS MANAGE_CODE FROM CBCI_COUPANG_STOCK CCS WHERE CCS.SHOP_ID = #{coupang_id} AND CCS.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CCS.EXTERNAL_VENDOR_SKU) <> '' AND CCS.MATCHING_CANCEL IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'NAVER_GOODS' AS SHOP, CNG.SHOP_ID, CNG.CUBICI_CODE, CNG.MATCHING_CODE, CNG.SELLER_PRODUCT_CODE AS MANAGE_CODE FROM CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG WHERE CNG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{naver_id}) AND CNG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CNG.SELLER_PRODUCT_CODE) <> '' AND CNG.MATCHING_CANCEL IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'NAVER_STOCK' AS SHOP, CNS.SHOP_ID, CNS.CUBICI_CODE, CNS.MATCHING_CODE, CNS.MANAGE_CODE FROM CBCI_NAVER_STOCK CNS WHERE CNS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{naver_id}) AND CNS.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CNS.MANAGE_CODE) <> '' AND CNS.MATCHING_CANCEL IS NULL) FIRST_CAL GROUP BY FIRST_CAL.MANAGE_CODE HAVING MATCHING_TABLE like "%^%"

SELECT LAST_CAL.* FROM ( SELECT SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 1, 1) AS A_YEAR, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'A' THEN '01' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'B' THEN '02' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'C' THEN '03' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'D' THEN '04' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'E' THEN '05' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'F' THEN '06' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'G' THEN '07' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'H' THEN '08' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'I' THEN '09' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'J' THEN '10' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'K' THEN '11' WHEN SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 2, 1) = 'L' THEN '12' END AS A_MONTH, SUBSTR(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE, 3, 2) AS A_DATE, FIRST_CAL.* FROM ( SELECT 'NAVER_GOODS' AS SHOP, CNG.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG WHERE CNG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CNG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'NAVER_STOCK' AS SHOP, CNS.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_NAVER_STOCK CNS WHERE CNS.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'COUPANG_STOCK' AS SHOP, CCS.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_COUPANG_STOCK CCS WHERE CCS.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'GMARKET_GOODS' AS SHOP, CGG.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_GOODS CGG WHERE CGG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CGG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'GMARKET_STOCK' AS SHOP, CGS.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_STOCK CGS WHERE CGS.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CGS.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'INTERPARK_GOODS' AS SHOP, CIG.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_GOODS CIG WHERE CIG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CIG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'INTERPARK_STOCK' AS SHOP, CIS.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_STOCK CIS WHERE CIS.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '11ST_GOODS' AS SHOP, CSG.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_11ST_GOODS CSG WHERE CSG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CSG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'AUCTION_GOODS' AS SHOP, CAG.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_AUCTION_GOODS CAG WHERE CAG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CAG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL ) FIRST_CAL ORDER BY FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE DESC LIMIT 1 ) LAST_CAL WHERE DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y%m%d') = CONCAT('202', A_YEAR, A_MONTH, A_DATE)

SELECT FIRST_CAL.* FROM ( SELECT CIG.UPD_DATE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_GOODS CIG WHERE CIG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{interpark_id}) UNION ALL SELECT CIS.UPD_DATE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_STOCK CIS WHERE CIS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{interpark_id}) UNION ALL SELECT CGG.UPD_DATE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_GOODS CGG WHERE CGG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{gmarket_id}) UNION ALL SELECT CGS.UPD_DATE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_STOCK CGS WHERE CGS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{gmarket_id}) UNION ALL SELECT CAG.UPD_DATE FROM CBCI_AUCTION_GOODS CAG WHERE CAG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{auction_id}) UNION ALL SELECT CSG.UPD_DATE FROM CBCI_11ST_GOODS CSG WHERE CSG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{eleven_id}) UNION ALL SELECT CCG.INPUT_DATE FROM CBCI_COUPANG_GOODS CCG WHERE CCG.SHOP_ID = #{coupang_id} UNION ALL SELECT CCS.UPD_DATE FROM CBCI_COUPANG_STOCK CCS WHERE CCS.SHOP_ID = #{coupang_id} UNION ALL SELECT CNG.UPD_DATE FROM CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG WHERE CNG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{naver_id}) UNION ALL SELECT CNS.UPD_DATE FROM CBCI_NAVER_STOCK CNS WHERE CNS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{naver_id}) ) FIRST_CAL ORDER BY FIRST_CAL.UPD_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FIRST_CAL.SHOP
, IF(FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL, "-", "M") AS MATCH_CHECK , FIRST_CAL.STATUS , FIRST_CAL.PRODUCT_NAME , FIRST_CAL.CATEGORY , FIRST_CAL.BRAND , FIRST_CAL.PRODUCT_NO , FIRST_CAL.MANAGE_CODE , FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE , FIRST_CAL.CUBICI_CODE , FIRST_CAL.OPTION1 , FIRST_CAL.OPTION2 , FIRST_CAL.OPTION3 , IFNULL(FIRST_CAL.PRICE, 0) AS SALE_PRICE , FIRST_CAL.HEAD_INVEN , IFNULL(FIRST_CAL.STOCK_QUANTITY, 0) AS STOCK_QUANTITY , DATE_FORMAT(FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE , IFNULL(FIRST_CAL.D_CHARGE, 0) AS D_CHARGE
, IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) AS MATCHED_SUM
, IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) AS NONMATCHED_SUM
FROM ( SELECT MATCH_TB.* FROM ( SELECT 1 AS SHOP_TYPE, '인터파크' AS SHOP, 'INTERPARK_GOODS' AS DIVISION, CIG.SHOP_ID, CIG.CUBICI_CODE, CIG.PRODUCT_NO, CIG.MATCHING_CODE, CIG.SELLER_PRODUCT_CODE AS MANAGE_CODE, CIG.PRODUCT_IMG, CIG.PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, SUBSTRING_INDEX(CIG.CATEGORY, '>', -1) AS CATEGORY, CIG.STOCK_QUANTITY, CIG.SELL_PRICE AS PRICE, CIG.SALES_STATUS AS STATUS, CIG.BRAND_NM AS BRAND, CIG.UPD_DATE, '' AS OPTION1, '' AS OPTION2, '' AS OPTION3, CIG.HEADQUARTER_INVENTORY AS HEAD_INVEN, CIG.DELIVERY_CHARGE AS D_CHARGE, DATE_FORMAT(CIG.PRODUCT_REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_GOODS CIG WHERE CIG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{INTERPARK_ID}) AND CIG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CIG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CIG.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS SHOP_TYPE, '인터파크' AS SHOP, 'INTERPARK_STOCK' AS DIVISION, CIS.SHOP_ID, CIS.CUBICI_CODE, CIG.PRODUCT_NO, CIS.MATCHING_CODE, CIS.MANAGE_CODE, CIG.PRODUCT_IMG, CONCAT(CIG.PRODUCT_NM, ' / ', CIS.OPTION1, ' ', CIS.OPTION2) AS PRODUCT_NAME, SUBSTRING_INDEX(CIG.CATEGORY, '>', -1) AS CATEGORY, CIS.OPTION_QUANTITY AS STOCK_QUANTITY, CIG.SELL_PRICE + CIS.ADD_PRICE AS PRICE, CIG.SALES_STATUS AS STATUS, CIG.BRAND_NM AS BRAND, CIG.UPD_DATE, CIS.OPTION1 AS OPTION1, CIS.OPTION2 AS OPTION2, '' AS OPTION3, CIS.HEADQUARTER_INVENTORY AS HEAD_INVEN, CIG.DELIVERY_CHARGE AS D_CHARGE, DATE_FORMAT(CIG.PRODUCT_REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_STOCK CIS LEFT JOIN CBCI_INTERPARK_GOODS CIG ON CIS.SHOP_ID = CIG.SHOP_ID AND CIS.PRODUCT_NO = CIG.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CIS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{INTERPARK_ID})
AND CIS.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CIS.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS SHOP_TYPE, '지마켓' AS SHOP, 'GMARKET_GOODS' AS DIVISION, CGG.SHOP_ID, CGG.CUBICI_CODE, CGG.PRODUCT_NO, CGG.MATCHING_CODE, CGG.SELLER_PRODUCT_CODE AS MANAGE_CODE, CGG.PRODUCT_IMG, CGG.PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, (CASE WHEN CGG.DETAIL_CATEGORY = '' THEN CGG.SUB_CATEGORY ELSE CGG.DETAIL_CATEGORY END) AS CATEGORY, CGG.STOCK_QUANTITY, CGG.SELL_PRICE AS PRICE, CGG.SALES_STATUS AS STATUS, CGG.BRAND_NM AS BRAND, CGG.UPD_DATE, '' AS OPTION1, '' AS OPTION2, '' AS OPTION3, CGG.HEADQUARTER_INVENTORY AS HEAD_INVEN, CGG.DELIVERY_CHARGE AS D_CHARGE, DATE_FORMAT(CGG.PRODUCT_REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_GOODS CGG WHERE CGG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{GMARKET_ID}) AND CGG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CGG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CGG.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS SHOP_TYPE, '지마켓' AS SHOP, 'GMARKET_STOCK' AS DIVISION, CGS.SHOP_ID, CGS.CUBICI_CODE, CGG.PRODUCT_NO, CGS.MATCHING_CODE, CGS.MANAGE_CODE, CGG.PRODUCT_IMG, CONCAT(CGG.PRODUCT_NM, ' / ', CGS.OPTION1, ' ', CGS.OPTION2, ' ', CGS.OPTION3) AS PRODUCT_NAME, (CASE WHEN CGG.DETAIL_CATEGORY = '' THEN CGG.SUB_CATEGORY ELSE CGG.DETAIL_CATEGORY END) AS CATEGORY, CGS.OPTION_STOCK AS STOCK_QUANTITY, CGG.SELL_PRICE + CGS.ADD_PRICE AS PRICE, CGG.SALES_STATUS AS STATUS, CGG.BRAND_NM AS BRAND, CGG.UPD_DATE, CGS.OPTION1 AS OPTION1, CGS.OPTION2 AS OPTION2, CGS.OPTION3 AS OPTION3, CGS.HEADQUARTER_INVENTORY AS HEAD_INVEN, CGG.DELIVERY_CHARGE AS D_CHARGE, DATE_FORMAT(CGG.PRODUCT_REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_STOCK CGS LEFT JOIN CBCI_GMARKET_GOODS CGG ON CGS.SHOP_ID = CGG.SHOP_ID AND CGS.PRODUCT_NO = CGG.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CGS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{GMARKET_ID})
AND CGS.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CGS.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS SHOP_TYPE, '옥션' AS SHOP, 'AUCTION_GOODS' AS DIVISION, CAG.SHOP_ID, CAG.CUBICI_CODE, CAG.ITEM_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, CAG.MATCHING_CODE, CAG.MANAGEMENT_CODE AS MANAGE_CODE, NULL AS PRODUCT_IMG, CAG.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, SUBSTRING_INDEX(CAG.CATEGORY_NAME, '>', -1) AS CATEGORY, CAG.SUM_STOCK_QTY AS STOCK_QUANTITY, CAG.SELLING_PRICE AS PRICE, CAG.SELLING_STATUS_CODE AS STATUS, CAG.BRAND_NAME AS BRAND, CAG.UPD_DATE, '' AS OPTION1, '' AS OPTION2, '' AS OPTION3, CAG.HEADQUARTER_INVENTORY AS HEAD_INVEN, CAG.SHIPPING_COST AS D_CHARGE, DATE_FORMAT(CAG.ITEM_REGIST_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE FROM CBCI_AUCTION_GOODS CAG WHERE CAG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{AUCTION_ID})
AND CAG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CAG.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS SHOP_TYPE, '11번가' AS SHOP, '11ST_GOODS' AS DIVISION, CSG.SHOP_ID, CSG.CUBICI_CODE, CSG.PRODUCT_NO, CSG.MATCHING_CODE, CSG.SELLER_PRD_CD AS MANAGE_CODE, NULL AS PRODUCT_IMG, CSG.PRD_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, SUBSTRING_INDEX(CSG.CATEGORY_NAME, '>', -1) AS CATEGORY, CSG.QUANTITY AS STOCK_QUANTITY, CSG.SEL_PRC AS PRICE, CSG.SEL_STAT_NM AS STATUS, CSG.BRAND_NAME AS BRAND, CSG.UPD_DATE, '' AS OPTION1, '' AS OPTION2, '' AS OPTION3, CSG.HEADQUARTER_INVENTORY AS HEAD_INVEN, '0' AS D_CHARGE, DATE_FORMAT(CSG.PRODUCT_REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE FROM CBCI_11ST_GOODS CSG WHERE CSG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{ELEVEN_ID})
AND CSG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CSG.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 11 AS SHOP_TYPE, '쿠팡' AS SHOP, 'COUPANG_STOCK' AS DIVISION, CCS.SHOP_ID, CCS.CUBICI_CODE, CCS.SELLER_PRODUCT_ID AS PRODUCT_NO, CCS.MATCHING_CODE, CCS.EXTERNAL_VENDOR_SKU AS MANAGE_CODE, CCS.CDN_PATH_1 AS PRODUCT_IMG, CONCAT(CCG.SELLER_PRODUCT_NM, ' / ', CCS.ITEM_NAME) AS PRODUCT_NAME, (SELECT CATEGORY_NAME FROM CBCI_COUPANG_CATEGORY CCC WHERE CATEGORY_CODE = CCG.CATEGORY_CODE) AS CATEGORY, CCS.OPT_AMOUNT_IN_STOCK AS STOCK_QUANTITY, CCS.SALE_PRICE AS PRICE, CCG.STATUS_NAME AS STATUS, CCG.BRAND, CCS.UPD_DATE, CCS.ITEM_NAME AS OPTION1, '' AS OPTION2, '' AS OPTION3, CCS.HEADQUARTER_INVENTORY AS HEAD_INVEN, CCG.DELIVERY_CHARGE AS D_CHARGE, DATE_FORMAT(CCG.CREATED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE FROM CBCI_COUPANG_STOCK CCS LEFT JOIN CBCI_COUPANG_GOODS CCG ON CCS.SHOP_ID = CCG.SHOP_ID AND CCS.SELLER_PRODUCT_ID = CCG.SELLER_PRODUCT_ID WHERE CCS.SHOP_ID = #{COUPANG_ID} AND CCS.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CCS.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CCS.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 14 AS SHOP_TYPE, '네이버' AS SHOP, 'NAVER_GOODS' AS DIVISION, CNG.SHOP_ID, CNG.CUBICI_CODE, CNG.PRODUCT_NO, CNG.MATCHING_CODE, CNG.SELLER_PRODUCT_CODE AS MANAGE_CODE, CNG.PRODUCT_IMG, CNG.PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, (CASE WHEN CNG.DETAIL_CATEGORY = '' THEN CNG.SUB_CATEGORY ELSE CNG.DETAIL_CATEGORY END) AS CATEGORY, CNG.STOCK_QUANTITY, CNG.SELL_PRICE AS PRICE, CNG.SALES_STATUS AS STATUS, CNG.BRAND_NM AS BRAND, CNG.UPD_DATE, '' AS OPTION1, '' AS OPTION2, '' AS OPTION3, CNG.HEADQUARTER_INVENTORY AS HEAD_INVEN, CNG.DELIVERY_CHARGE AS D_CHARGE, DATE_FORMAT(CNG.PRODUCT_REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE FROM CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG WHERE CNG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{NAVER_ID}) AND CNG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CNG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CNG.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 14 AS SHOP_TYPE, '네이버' AS SHOP, 'NAVER_STOCK' AS DIVISION, CNS.SHOP_ID, CNS.CUBICI_CODE, CNG.PRODUCT_NO, CNS.MATCHING_CODE, CNS.MANAGE_CODE, CNG.PRODUCT_IMG, CONCAT(CNG.PRODUCT_NM, ' / ', CNS.OPTION_NM_1, CNS.OPTION_NM_2, CNS.OPTION_NM_3) AS PRODUCT_NAME, (CASE WHEN CNG.DETAIL_CATEGORY = '' THEN CNG.SUB_CATEGORY ELSE CNG.DETAIL_CATEGORY END) AS CATEGORY, CNS.OPTION_QUANTITY AS STOCK_QUANTITY, CNG.SELL_PRICE + CNS.OPTION_PRICE AS PRICE, CNG.SALES_STATUS AS STATUS, CNG.BRAND_NM AS BRAND, CNS.UPD_DATE, CNS.OPTION_NM_1 AS OPTION1, CNS.OPTION_NM_2 AS OPTION2, CNS.OPTION_NM_3 AS OPTION3, CNG.HEADQUARTER_INVENTORY AS HEAD_INVEN, CNG.DELIVERY_CHARGE AS D_CHARGE, DATE_FORMAT(CNG.PRODUCT_REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE FROM CBCI_NAVER_STOCK CNS LEFT JOIN CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG ON CNS.SHOP_ID = CNG.SHOP_ID AND CNS.PRODUCT_NO = CNG.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CNS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{NAVER_ID})
AND CNS.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND CNS.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL
) MATCH_TB ) FIRST_CAL WHERE FIRST_CAL.STATUS IN (${sale_status}) AND FIRST_CAL.SHOP_TYPE IN (${SHOP_TYPE_LIST}) AND FIRST_CAL.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%${searchName}%'
GROUP BY FIRST_CAL.SHOP
ORDER BY FIRST_CAL.MATCHING_CODE ASC, FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE ASC
ORDER BY FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE
